attempted_claim: For every n >= 1, construct a torsion-free group G such that (i) G satisfies property (FW_n), i.e. every action of G on a median graph (1-skeleton of a CAT(0) cube complex) of cubical dimension n stabilises a cube (has bounded orbits), and (ii) G acts properly and cocompactly on a median graph of cubical dimension n+1.
decisive_failure: No construction or impossibility proof for the target was obtained. Five structural routes (virtual inheritance, Higman ellipticity, product lattices, NPC quotients, affine Coxeter passage) were each blocked; the bounded one-vertex enumeration rules out only the necessary H1 condition in the smallest regime and does not constrain multi-vertex or higher-generator candidates. Artifacts cover only the recovery test, not a target resolution.
